# This test checks that -coverpkg=all can be used
# when the package pattern includes packages
# which only have tests.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/27333, golang.org/issue/43242.

[short] skip
cd $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/cov

env BOLERO_MODULE=on
bolero test -coverpkg=all ./...

env BOLERO_MODULE=off
bolero test -coverpkg=all ./...

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/cov/go.mod --
module example.com/cov

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/cov/notest/notest.go --
package notest

func Foo() {}

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/cov/onlytest/onlytest_test.go --
package onlytest_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/cov/notest"
)

func TestFoo(t *testing.T) {
	notest.Foo()
}

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/cov/withtest/withtest.go --
package withtest

func Bar() {}

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/cov/withtest/withtest_test.go --
package withtest

import "testing"

func TestBar(t *testing.T) {
	Bar()
}
